title: Scaling Test-Time Compute Optimally Can Be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
abstract: We study allocation of inference-time compute across reasoning chains. The reweighting trick mentioned here matches the test-time scaling protocol used downstream, scoring 73.4% in the held-out evaluation.

title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
abstract: Adam is a first-order gradient-based optimisation method using adaptive estimates of lower-order moments; we report convergence on standard benchmarks.
